I = importlib

metadata = Hash()
balances = Hash(default_value=0)

total_supply = Variable()

BURN_ADDRESS = 'BURN_THE_KING'

@construct
def seed():
    total_supply = Variable(10_000_000_000)

    balances[ctx.caller] = total_supply.get()

    metadata['token_name'] = "King Token"
    metadata['token_symbol'] = "KING"
    metadata['operator'] = ctx.caller
    metadata['dex'] = 'con_rocketswap_official_v1_1'
    metadata['min_supply'] = 10_000_000
    metadata['threshold'] = 500
    metadata['bonus'] = 0.05
    metadata['burn'] = 0.01

    # Checks for redeem()
    metadata['redeem_burn'] = 'true'
    metadata['redeem_check_supply'] = 'true'
    metadata['redeem_add_liquidity'] = 'true'

    # Checks for sell()
    metadata['sell_tax'] = 'true'  # TODO
    metadata['sell_to_owner'] = 'false'  # TODO
    metadata['sell_add_liquidity'] = 'false'  # TODO

@export
def change_metadata(key: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only owner can set metadata'
    metadata[key] = value

@export
def transfer(amount: float, to: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances!'
    assert balances[ctx.caller] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send'

    if to == BURN_ADDRESS: total_supply.set(total_supply.get() - amount)

    balances[ctx.caller] -= amount
    balances[to] += amount

@export
def approve(amount: float, to: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances'
    balances[ctx.caller, to] += amount

@export
def transfer_from(amount: float, to: str, main_account: str):
    assert amount > 0, 'Cannot send negative balances'
    assert balances[main_account, ctx.caller] >= amount, f'You approved {balances[main_account, ctx.caller]} but need {amount}'
    assert balances[main_account] >= amount, 'Not enough coins to send'

    if to == BURN_ADDRESS: total_supply.set(total_supply.get() - amount)

    balances[main_account, ctx.caller] -= amount
    balances[main_account] -= amount
    balances[to] += amount

@export
def redeem(token_amount: float, token_contract: str):
    # Send tokens to this contract
    I.import_module(token_contract).transfer_from(amount, ctx.this, ctx.caller)

    # Sell tokens on DEX
    # TODO: Check Testnet Explorer
    value = I.import_module(metadata['dex']).sell(token_contract, token_amount)

    # Make sure value is equal or bigger than threshold
    assert value >= metadata['threshold'], f'Amount must be worth at least {metadata["threshold"]} TAU'

    if metadata['redeem_add_liquidity'] == 'true':
        # Provide liquidity for KING on DEX
        # TODO: https://testnet-master-1.lamden.io/contracts/con_amm_v9/reserves?key=con_the_one2
        I.import_module(metadata['dex']).add_liquidity(ctx.this, value)

    king_amount = value / ForeignHash(metadata['dex'], 'prices')[ctx.this]
    king_total = king_amount + (king_amount * metadata['bonus'])

    # Pay user with KING + bonus
    # https://testnet-master-1.lamden.io/contracts/con_the_one2/balances?key=con_the_one2
    transfer_from(king_total, ctx.caller, ctx.this)

    if metadata['redeem_burn'] == 'true':
        # https://testnet-master-1.lamden.io/contracts/con_the_one2/balances?key=BURN_THE_KING
        transfer_from(king_total * metadata['burn'], BURN_ADDRESS, ctx.this)

    if metadata['redeem_check_supply'] == 'true':
        # Check if total supply is lower than allowed
        assert total_supply.get() >= metadata['min_supply'], f'Cannot fall below minimum supply'

@export
def burn(amount: float):
    transfer_from(amount, BURN_ADDRESS, ctx.this)
    assert_owner()

@export
def remove_liquidity(amount: float):
    I.import_module(metadata['dex']).remove_liquidity(ctx.this, amount)
    assert_owner()

@export
def withdraw_external(amount: float, token_contract: str):
    I.import_module(token_contract).transfer(amount, ctx.caller)  # TODO: transfer_from() needed? What's with approval()?
    assert_owner()

@export
def withdraw_internal(amount: float, contract_name: str=''):
    contract_name = contract_name if contract_name else ctx.this
    transfer_from(amount, ctx.caller, contract_name)
    assert_owner()

def assert_owner():
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only executable by owner'
